responsibility: This header is GCC’s VxWorks-specific replacement entry point for <stdint.h>. Unlike the neighboring wrappers that forward through _yvals-wrapper.h to an underlying system header, it first includes GCC’s VxWorks _yvals.h policy shim and then includes GCC’s generic <stdint-gcc.h>, making GCC itself the provider of the exact-width integer typedefs, limits, and related standard integer macros while still applying the VxWorks/Dinkumware configuration needed for this target environment.
